story.quote: What if travellers could experience the destination before they ever travelled?
story.p1: TravelMateVR is developed by Mates Technologies Limited in Mbeya, Tanzania. It connects travellers, tourism businesses, destinations and local communities in one immersive, AI-enabled platform.
story.p2: Travel starts with curiosity, inspiration and confidence, not with a checkout page. So we put the experience first, and make planning, booking and staying connected feel effortless.

hero.title: See it before you go.
hero.text: Step inside destinations, stays and safaris before you book flights, rooms or tours. Know exactly what you're choosing, then travel with confidence.

dest.title: Africa's immersive tourism gateway
dest.text: We're building the way the world gets to know African destinations: by experiencing them first. Start in Tanzania, then keep going.
dest.worldNote: Destinations beyond Africa are preview-only for now: explore them in 360° today, book when we launch there.

ai.title: Your personal AI travel companion
ai.text: Loved what you saw? Tell your companion how you like to travel. It turns it into routes, stays, budgets and a day-by-day plan you can change, save and book.
ai.example: I have $2,500, seven days and I want wildlife, culture and beaches.

vision.title: The future of travel starts before you arrive.
vision.p1: Travel decisions should be based on experience, not guesswork. Today people spend real money on places they've only seen in a few photos.
vision.p2: TravelMateVR changes that. Built in Mbeya, Tanzania, for travellers everywhere, we're making it normal to walk a destination before you book it.

q1.a: A way to experience destinations before you travel. Look around places, stays and tours in 360°, plan your trip, then book trusted local partners with confidence.

q2.q: Do I need a VR headset?
q2.a: No. Everything works on your phone or computer. A headset simply makes it even more immersive.

q3.a: Yes. Exploring destinations and experiences and planning your trip are free. You only pay when you book a service.

q4.a: Bookings and payments are open in Tanzania, including Zanzibar. Other destinations are preview-only until we launch there.

q5.a: With M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Mixx by Yas, HaloPesa, or a Visa or Mastercard card from any bank.

q6.a: Choose Become a Partner and tell us about your business. We check your licence, help you set up and you can start welcoming more confident travellers.

final.title: Travel with confidence.
final.text: Experience destinations before you travel. Then go, knowing exactly what's waiting for you.
